kiel-eckernfoerde-damp-coastline.title: Kiel · Eckernförde and Damp Coastline Ride
kiel-eckernfoerde-damp-coastline.slogan: A 171 km loop out of Eckernförde bay
kiel-eckernfoerde-damp-coastline.story: Beach air, holiday traffic discipline and a better return line. The best part sits around Eckernförde bay, Damp coast road, Schwansen fields, while the most useful town stop keeps the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel or food hunt. Check the OSM map, Google preview and GPX checkpoint order before departure; they use the same waypoint sequence. Ride it with legal pull-offs, patience through villages and enough daylight to stop without rushing.

scenicChapters.title: Damp coast road → Schwansen fields
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 30 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

scenicChapters.title: Murghab → Ak Baital Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 6.7%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter — first and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding.

scenicChapters.title: Ak Baital Pass → Karakul
scenicChapters.narrative: 4655 m come off over 87 km at around 7.4%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.

pamir-highway.story: From Dushanbe it runs 1242 km to the finish; allow about 17 h 31 of riding. The stops in between: Kalaikhum, Khorog, Murghab and Ak Baital Pass. The highest point is about 4,650 m. It crosses from Tajikistan into Kyrgyzstan - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
